main_text.l: Viri Clariss. Johannis Lightfooti, Aliorum-que sententiae de Otiosis examinantur: varia de Synagogis, earumque Iure, Praefectis, Ministris, &c. adspergunntur.
Apud JOHANNEM GYSELAAR, Ordd. Frisiae atque eorundem Academiae Typograph. Ordinar. MDCLXXXVI.

page.notes: Woodcut emblem below the title lines: a Hebrew tetragrammaton within rays above a crowd, with a banner bearing the Latin words "EGO IEHO... VOCAVI ... AVOCAVI ... TE IVM" (partly illegible). Hebrew letters in the emblem are not transcribed. Some title words are in italic and small capitals as shown; the "In quibus" line is italic. Spelling "adspergunntur" is as printed; "Iure" and "Praefectis" are as printed, with the long-s forms rendered as plain s.
